attchmntText: Generic Engineering Construction and Projects Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
sm_name: Generic Engineering Construction and Projects Limited
voiceSummary: Generic Engineering Construction and Projects Limited approved un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on November 14, 2026. Statutory auditor Bilimoria Mehta and Co issued a modified conclusion with a qualified opinion. The qualification arises because the company did not provide sufficient cost records for work-in-progress inventories, preventing verification of valuation. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, segment revenue was 5,272.94 lakhs. Profit before tax was 220.81 lakhs. Profit after tax was 220.40 lakhs. Total segment assets stood at 53,079.41 lakhs. The group invested in Generic Bootes Constructions LLP. Management assessed that new Labour Codes have no material impact on gratuity obligations.
